info.title: DataGovIL.Api
info.description: Sample .NET Core Web API on top of the data.gov.il CKAN datastore (vehicle registrations + WLTP makes/models).

get.summary: Paginated list of car manufacturers and models (from the WLTP makes/models dataset).

parameters.name: manufacturer
parameters.description: Optional exact manufacturer name filter (e.g. "טויוטה יפן").

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Optional commercial model-name search (e.g. "COROLLA" also matches "COROLLA CROSS").

get.summary: Look up a single make/model by manufacturer code (`tozeret_cd`) and model code (`degem_cd`).

post.summary:
Queues a background export of the full WLTP make/model catalog to data.csv
(one row per unique tozeret_cd + degem_cd). Returns immediately.

get.summary: Poll progress/completion of the manufacturer CSV export.

Look up new-vehicle price-list rows by manufacturer code (`tozeret_cd`),
model code (`degem_cd`), and manufacture year (`shnat_yitzur`).

Technical + ownership history for a registration number
(`mispar_rechev`) from the two history datastore resources.

Look up a single vehicle by its exact registration number (מספר רישוי).
When the active registries miss, falls back to permanently-cancelled ("ביטול סופי")
resources and then to inactive ("לא פעיל") resources, then personal-import vehicles.
A found vehicle is also checked
against the safety-systems discount list and the open-recall list, and gets a
depreciation calculation (kilometers, owner count, ownership type) from its history and price list.
Paged/free-text search across the vehicle registration dataset.

DepreciationOwnerCategory.description: Matches the Delphi `ot*` constants; the value is the column index in the loss table.

DepreciationVehicleCategory.description: Matches the Delphi `ct*` constants; the value is the row index in the loss table.

estimatedTotalRawRows.description:
CKAN's include_total figure from the first page. The WLTP resource currently returns
an estimate (`total_was_estimated`), so this is progress context only — not a
stop condition.

outputFile.description:
Destination of the last successful sync (e.g. `postgresql:public.manufacturer_models`).
Kept as `OutputFile` for API compatibility with the former CSV export.

inserted.description: Totals across all synced tables; see DataGovIL.Api.Models.ManufacturerExportStatus.Tables for the per-table breakdown.

tables.description: Delta per table, keyed by table name (e.g. `manufacturers`, `manufacturer_models`).

ManufacturerExportStatus.description: Snapshot of the in-process manufacturer CSV export job (single-instance deployment).

feeGroupPrice.description: שווי שימוש חודשי משוער (₪), derived from feeGroupCode.

estimatedLicenseFee.description: אגרת רישוי משוערת (₪) for the current fee year, from feeGroupCode and the vehicle's first registration date. Set only on vehicle lookups; null on catalog rows, which have no registration date.

automaticHighBeamControlRegulationSource.description: מקור התקנה שליטה אוטומטית באורות גבוהים

emergencyBrakingPedestriansCyclists.description: בלימת חירום לפני הולכי רגל ואופניים

ManufacturerModelRecord.description:
Public API shape for a WLTP make/model row.
Serialized with ASP.NET's default camelCase names (`manufacturerName`, not `tozeret_nm`).
Built from DataGovIL.Api.Models.ManufacturerModelDatastoreRecord after CKAN deserialization.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching rows, when known (datastore include_total).

ManufacturerSyncDelta.description: Counts from a manufacturer catalog delta sync.

value.description: Null when no price-list price was found.

depreciationValue.description: סה"כ שינוי ערך בש"ח. Null when no price-list price was found.

carAge.description: גיל הרכב בשנים, from the road entry date to today.

ownershipType.description: סוג הבעלות שנבחר לחישוב (the highest-loss type across owners and originality)

VehicleDepreciationRecord.description:
Vehicle value adjustment (ירידת ערך) from kilometers, owner count, and ownership type.
Percents are signed: negative lowers the value, positive raises it.

ownershipHistory.description: Ownership timeline rows (typically multiple), newest first when sortable.

VehicleHistoryRecord.description:
Combined vehicle history from the technical and ownership datastore resources,
keyed by registration number (`mispar_rechev`).

VehicleOwnershipHistoryRecord.description:
Public API shape for one ownership-history row.
DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehicleOwnershipHistoryRecord.OwnershipYearMonth is from `baalut_dt` (typically `yyyyMM`).

VehiclePriceListRecord.description:
Public API shape for a new-vehicle price-list row (יבואנים ומחירוני רכב חדש).
Serialized with ASP.NET camelCase names.

estimatedWarrantyEndDate.description: סיום אחריות יצרן משוערת: roadEntryDate + 36 months. Null without a road entry date.

estimatedWarrantyActive.description: אחריות יצרן משוערת בתוקף. Null without a road entry date.

isSafetyDiscountEligible.description: זכאי להנחה לאחר התקנת מערכות בטיחות

VehicleRecord.description:
Public API shape for a vehicle registration row (active, inactive, or permanently cancelled).
Serialized with ASP.NET's default camelCase names.
Built from DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehicleDatastoreRecord, DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehicleCancelledDatastoreRecord,
DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehicleInactiveWithoutModelCodeDatastoreRecord, DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehicleSafetyDiscountDatastoreRecord,
or DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehiclePersonalImportDatastoreRecord.

totalCount.description: Total number of matching rows, when known (datastore include_total).

VehicleTechnicalHistoryRecord.description:
Public API shape for technical vehicle history.
`*Indicator` fields are bool (datastore 0/1).
DataGovIL.Api.Models.VehicleTechnicalHistoryRecord.FirstRegistrationDate is from `rishum_rishon_dt`.
